bibl.title: A Set of Astronomical Papyri Seen by Albert Rehm.
bibl.seg: Alexander Jones, A Set of Astronomical Papyri Seen by Albert Rehm.
bibl.note: Among the Nachlass of Albert Rehm (Bayerische Staatsbibliothek, Munich) is a small folder labelled "Astronomischer Papyrus in München". The present location of the papyri is unknown.
